'''Cyr Hassk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cioran]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Serving as an associated of [[Japet Saun]], he worked as a dockhand at a spaceport. In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was visited by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], disguised as an Imperial officer, and asked about the whereabouts of Hassk's acquaintance, Japet. After a brief scuffle, Hassk told the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebel]] where to find Japet's girlfriend, [[Aminni]].<ref name="HAT" />
